candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business Crown Castle Inc. (CCI) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. Crown Castle owns and leases shared communications infrastructure, including towers and fiber, primarily to wireless carriers. We are not a retail wireless network operator. Principal operations: Crown Castle Inc.. Reported segments include: Towers (68% of revenue); Fiber (32% of revenue). Our infrastructure/operating model includes: communications infrastructure landlord. We lease communications sites to wireless carriers and are not a retail wireless network operator.
